The NFT token ID representing the agricultural asset

params.amount: Amount of USDC to deposit (6 decimals)

params.tokenId: The ID of the undercollateralized AgroNFT

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

params.tokenId: The ID of the collateralized AgroNFT

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

params.tokenId: The ID of the AgroNFT to withdraw

borrow(uint256,uint256).notice: Borrows stablecoin (USDC) against the deposited AgroNFT collateral.

depositCollateral(uint256).notice: Deposits an AgroNFT into the pool as collateral for borrowing.

depositLiquidity(uint256).notice: Lenders deposit MockUSDC to earn yield and fund agricultural credit.

executeParametricLiquidation(uint256).notice: Executes parametric liquidation when Health Factor drops below solvency threshold (< 1.00). Bypasses judicial repossession by transferring tokenized harvest rights to liquidator upon debt settlement.

mintCollateral(address,string,uint256).notice: Helper allowing the oracle/middleware to mint collateral through the protocol interface.

repay(uint256,uint256).notice: Repays outstanding USDC debt on a loan.

updateLTVAndHealthFactor(uint256,uint256.notice: Updates LTV and Health Factor for a collateral token from the Web3 Oracle / Middleware.

withdrawCollateral(uint256).notice: Withdraws collateral NFT once loan is fully repaid.
